observations: Stainless steel gas cooker with three burners.
Three black control knobs are visible on the front panel.
A manufacturer's label is present on the right side of the unit.
The burners are covered by black metal grates.
The unit appears to be in clean condition from the top-down perspective.

claims.evidence: The photos show a clean surface, but 'fairly used' is subjective and cannot be confirmed remotely.
No photo shows the burners ignited or the unit powered on.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite or may have poor flame quality.
risks.proof: A video showing all three burners lit and burning steadily.

risks.risk: The gas inlet or valve may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit being lit and held in place without gas leaks.

risks.risk: The manufacturer's label may be missing or illegible.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label on the side of the cooker.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of all three burners lit and burning.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the side of the cooker.
Photo of the back of the unit showing the gas inlet and valve.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
